description: Pain detection model trained on UNBC-McMaster Shoulder Pain Expression Archive. Comparative model: takes target face + reference face, outputs PSPI via feature subtraction.
source: TaatiTeam/pain_detection_demo (converted from PyTorch, base comparative model)
output: 40 regression values. Last 3 are PSPI for [Dementia, Healthy, UNBC]. Use index -1 for UNBC PSPI (0-16 scale).
notes: Reference frame provided by calibration (patient's face at known pain level). Falls back to zero reference when uncalibrated.
